newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Petroplus buys Daewoo's Antwerp refinery.
newsitem.headline: Petroplus buys Daewoo's Antwerp refinery.

text.p: Dutch trading company Petroplus International said on Monday it had reached agreement with Korea's Daewoo to buy all the shares of Universal Refining in Antwerp.
No financial details were disclosed, but the company said the sale of the 65,000 barrel per day Belgian refinery would be effective on September 15.

Petroplus specialises in the trading, storage and distribution of bulk commodities and logistics and engineering activities on behalf of third parties and has a staff of 500, including those in Universal Refining.
The turnover should be about two billion guilders in 1997, the company said in a statement.
Petroplus is 33 percent owned by Dutch venture capital firm NPM and 33 percent each by its two directors.
